purpose: Soften or object to an unnecessary action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
何も + Vなくてもいい / negative necessity expression
There is no need to decide today.
There is no need to get so angry.
You do not have to shoulder everything alone.
formation: 何も + Vなくてもいい / negative necessity expression
restrictions: This use means “there is no need to”; ordinary 何もない simply means nothing.
mistake: Do not confuse lack of necessity with prohibition.
